findings.title: Recovery overwrites intervening manual file edits without preserving them
findings.reproduction: Inject OSError at real atomic replacement of search_plan.md; edit that file while transaction marker exists; call recover.
findings.expected: Refuse a preimage conflict before any replacement, or preserve changed bytes in recoverable history.
findings.observed: Queued after-image replaces manual edits and no .history copy contains the overwritten content.
findings.suggested_fix: Before applying any after-image, require every existing target to match the prior saved content hash or intended after-image; retain marker on conflict.
findings.resolution: Fixed by CaseStore owner: interrupted recovery checks existing content against acceptable transaction preimages and after-images before replacement; intervening manual edits are preserved rather than silently overwritten. Original regression passes unchanged.
